Class ExplosivePickaxe

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.SlimefunItem
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.implementation.items.SimpleSlimefunItem<ToolUseHandler>

    public class ExplosivePickaxe
extends ExplosiveTool
    The ExplosivePickaxe is a pickaxe which can destroy Blocks in a size of 3 by 3. It also creates a explosion animation.

    ExplosiveShovel, ExplosiveTool
